neighbours.label: the opening fragment of a rare proper name (usually a small place name) that the tokenizer splits into pieces
fire: The letter was postmarked in Swarthmore, Pennsylvania, on a Monday.
A farmer from Avonmore told reporters about the flood.
Their wedding took place at a chapel in Swaffham last June.
After the war he settled in Gaillac and opened a bakery.
The old railway once ran from Avebury to the coast.
My cousin teaches at a primary school near Swadlincote.
The regiment camped outside Vicenza for two weeks.
She grew up on a sheep farm close to Gaiman in Patagonia.
quiet: The letter was postmarked in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on a Monday.
A farmer from Ohio told reporters about the flood.
Their wedding took place at a chapel in London last June.
After the war he settled in Paris and opened a bakery.
The old railway once ran from Berlin to the coast.
My cousin teaches at a primary school near Manchester.
The regiment camped outside Rome for two weeks.
She grew up on a sheep farm close to Sydney in Australia.

predictions: split rare place names fire on the first piece; single-token common city names stay quiet
short: first piece of a split place name
notes: Probe: ' Sw'arraton 0.976, ' Av'ondale 0.786, ' Ga'ithersburg 0.392, ' V'icksburg 0.400; single-token Boston 0.047, Chicago 0.035. Leaks: 'Av'ocados 0.393, ' sw'ans 0.467, so the piece itself carries some activation; near misses use single-token cities.
